purpose: Threshold-free diagnostic of product-available deterministic weight reliability features for separating weight-error-driven topology evidence from reliable mechanical evidence.
partition_policy: Existing STRETCH_AND_L1_JSD partition is frozen before teacher evaluation.
features: predicted dominant bone distance / nearest-bone distance
weight-row L1 deviation from one-ring neighbor median
evaluation: ROC-AUC for face touches teacher-invalid row
distributions on unsafe actual-motion >10x false-negative cross-region faces
teacher_policy: Teacher validity/topology/weights are evaluation-only after product features and partition are frozen.
